verifiable-quality-gates.why: the pre-push fix is pinned by a test that FAILS when reverted: a gitignored sniffing file passes the hook (CI never scans it) and the SAME file once tracked blocks it, using the real no-ua-sniffing gate (#134)
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added an ISSUE-134 discrimination case to test/pre-push-hook.test.mjs; full suite 762 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: changing what the local pre-push scans (respect .gitignore) and the deliberate decision NOT to add a path-waiver that would relax the invoke-lock is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0082 covering the .gitignore fix, why it is not a waiver, and the honest scope (consumer template only; the deferred committed-path waiver)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: pinned at the level that owns it: an integration test that runs the real pre-push + the real no-ua-sniffing gate against a real git repo with a gitignored dir, asserting the hook's exit code both ways
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a real-gate, real-git-repo pre-push test for the gitignored-vs-tracked cases
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed: a sniffing file that is gitignored (must pass) and the same file tracked (must block)
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: a node:test case asserting both exit codes against the real gate
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: ADR-0082 states the honest scope rather than overclaiming: only the consumer template changes (the upstream repo's own .githooks/pre-push is a different mechanism), CI is unchanged, and the committed-path waiver is explicitly deferred, not delivered
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the scope + limits in ADR-0082 and verified the suite green before claiming the fix
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the pre-push delta before the PR, checking that the --ignore is appended only to gates that accept it, that it narrows to git's ignore set (not an arbitrary set), and that the manifest invoke is untouched
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no user input/auth/crypto surface; the hook runs a fixed `git ls-files` command (no shell, no user-controlled args) and passes paths to gates as argv elements, no injection path; defensive, not a product security control

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; a path-collection step added to the existing hook's gate loop

arch-encode.why: enforced by a discrimination test, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration or audit logic; this is local hook scan-scope

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism; a local pre-push pre-flight

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; developer-facing hook

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or frontend code; developer-facing hook

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; developer-facing hook
